ruleDefinitions.name: [Sigma] Process Memory Dump Via Comsvcs.DLL
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a process memory dump via "comsvcs.dll" using rundll32, covering multiple different techniques (ordinal, minidump function, etc.) | Sigma ID: 646ea171-dded-4578-8a4d-65e9822892e3 | Author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Modexp, Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems), Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems) | Reference: https://twitter.com/shantanukhande/status/1229348874298388484 | Reference: https://twitter.com/pythonresponder/status/1385064506049630211?s=21 | Reference: https://twitter.com/Hexacorn/status/1224848930795552769 | Reference: https://modexp.wordpress.com/2019/08/30/minidumpwritedump-via-com-services-dll/ | Reference: https://twitter.com/SBousseaden/status/1167417096374050817 | Reference: https://twitter.com/Wietze/status/1542107456507203586 | (truncated)

sequences.name: Sequence 1
sequences.query: activity_type:"process-create" AND ((((process_name:WLDi("*\\rundll32.exe") OR process_command_line:WLDi("*rundll32.exe*")) OR (process_name:"RUNDLL32.EXE" OR process_command_line:WLDi("*RUNDLL32.EXE*")) OR process_command_line:WLDi("*rundll32*"))) AND (((process_command_line:WLDi("*comsvcs*") OR process_command_line:WLDi("*full*")) AND (process_command_line:WLDi("*#-*") OR process_command_line:WLDi("*#\+*") OR process_command_line:WLDi("*#24*") OR process_command_line:WLDi("*24 *") OR process_command_line:WLDi("*MiniDump*") OR process_command_line:WLDi("*#65560*"))))) OR (((process_command_line:WLDi("*24*") OR process_command_line:WLDi("*comsvcs*") OR process_command_line:WLDi("*full*")) AND (process_command_line:WLDi("* #*") OR process_command_line:WLDi("*,#*") OR process_command_line:WLDi("*, #*") OR process_command_line:WLDi("*\"#*"))))

ruleDefinitions.name: [Sigma] Compress Data and Lock With Password for Exfiltration With 7-ZIP
ruleDefinitions.description: An adversary may compress or encrypt data that is collected prior to exfiltration using 3rd party utilities | Sigma ID: 9fbf5927-5261-4284-a71d-f681029ea574 | Author: frack113 | Reference: https://github.com/redcanaryco/atomic-red-team/blob/f339e7da7d05f6057fdfcdd3742bfcf365fee2a9/atomics/T1560.001/T1560.001.md | MITRE: attack.collection,attack.t1560.001 | Tags: attack.collection,attack.t1560.001

sequences.name: Sequence 1
sequences.query: activity_type:"process-create" AND ((additional_info:WLDi("*7-Zip*") OR ((process_name:WLDi("*\\7z.exe") OR process_command_line:WLDi("*7z.exe*")) OR (process_name:WLDi("*\\7zr.exe") OR process_command_line:WLDi("*7zr.exe*")) OR (process_name:WLDi("*\\7za.exe") OR process_command_line:WLDi("*7za.exe*"))) OR ((process_name:"7z.exe" OR process_command_line:WLDi("*7z.exe*")) OR (process_name:"7za.exe" OR process_command_line:WLDi("*7za.exe*")) OR (process_name:"7zr.exe" OR process_command_line:WLDi("*7zr.exe*")))) AND process_command_line:WLDi("* -p*") AND (process_command_line:WLDi("* a *") OR process_command_line:WLDi("* u *")))

ruleDefinitions.name: [Sigma] Disabled MFA to Bypass Authentication Mechanisms
ruleDefinitions.description: Detection for when multi factor authentication has been disabled, which might indicate a malicious activity to bypass authentication mechanisms. | Sigma ID: 7ea78478-a4f9-42a6-9dcd-f861816122bf | Author: @ionsor | Reference: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/active-directory/authentication/howto-mfa-userstates | MITRE: attack.credential-access,attack.persistence,attack.defense-impairment,attack.t1556 | Tags: attack.credential-access,attack.persistence,attack.defense-impairment,attack.t1556

sequences.name: Sequence 1
sequences.query: ((service_name:"AzureActiveDirectory" AND operation:"Disable Strong Authentication." AND result:"success"))

ruleDefinitions.name: [Sigma] RDP Port Forwarding Rule Added Via Netsh.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of netsh to configure a port forwarding of port 3389 (RDP) rule | Sigma ID: 782d6f3e-4c5d-4b8c-92a3-1d05fed72e63 | Author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), oscd.community | Reference: https://www.fireeye.com/blog/threat-research/2019/01/bypassing-network-restrictions-through-rdp-tunneling.html | MITRE: attack.lateral-movement,attack.command-and-control,attack.t1090 | Tags: attack.lateral-movement,attack.command-and-control,attack.t1090

sequences.name: Sequence 1
sequences.query: activity_type:"process-create" AND (((process_name:WLDi("*\\netsh.exe") OR process_command_line:WLDi("*netsh.exe*")) OR (process_name:"netsh.exe" OR process_command_line:WLDi("*netsh.exe*"))) AND (process_command_line:WLDi("* i*") OR process_command_line:WLDi("* p*") OR process_command_line:WLDi("*=3389*") OR process_command_line:WLDi("* c*")))

ruleDefinitions.name: [Sigma] Suspicious Inbox Forwarding Identity Protection

ruleDefinitions.name: [Sigma] Boot Configuration Tampering Via Bcdedit.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of the bcdedit command to tamper with the boot configuration data. This technique is often times used by malware or attackers as a destructive way before launching ransomware. | Sigma ID: 1444443e-6757-43e4-9ea4-c8fc705f79a2 | Author: E.M. Anhaus (originally from Atomic Blue Detections, Endgame), oscd.community | Reference: https://github.com/redcanaryco/atomic-red-team/blob/f339e7da7d05f6057fdfcdd3742bfcf365fee2a9/atomics/T1490/T1490.md | Reference: https://eqllib.readthedocs.io/en/latest/analytics/c4732632-9c1d-4980-9fa8-1d98c93f918e.html | MITRE: attack.impact,attack.t1490 | Tags: attack.impact,attack.t1490

sequences.name: Sequence 1
sequences.query: activity_type:"process-create" AND (((process_name:WLDi("*\\bcdedit.exe") OR process_command_line:WLDi("*bcdedit.exe*")) OR (process_name:"bcdedit.exe" OR process_command_line:WLDi("*bcdedit.exe*"))) AND process_command_line:WLDi("*set*") AND ((process_command_line:WLDi("*bootstatuspolicy*") OR process_command_line:WLDi("*ignoreallfailures*")) OR (process_command_line:WLDi("*recoveryenabled*") OR process_command_line:WLDi("*no*"))))

ruleDefinitions.name: [Sigma] Shadow Copies Deletion Using Operating Systems Utilities
ruleDefinitions.description: Shadow Copies deletion using operating systems utilities | Sigma ID: c947b146-0abc-4c87-9c64-b17e9d7274a2 | Author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems), Michael Haag, Teymur Kheirkhabarov, Daniil Yugoslavskiy, oscd.community, Andreas Hunkeler (@Karneades) | Reference: https://www.slideshare.net/heirhabarov/hunting-for-credentials-dumping-in-windows-environment | Reference: https://blog.talosintelligence.com/2017/05/wannacry.html | Reference: https://securingtomorrow.mcafee.com/other-blogs/mcafee-labs/new-teslacrypt-ransomware-arrives-via-spam/ | Reference: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/why-everyone-should-disable-vssadmin-exe-now/ | Reference: https://www.hybrid-analysis.com/sample/ed01ebfbc9eb5bbea545af4d01bf5f1071661840480439c6e5babe8e080e41aa?environmentId=100 | Reference: https://github.com/Neo23x0/Raccine | (truncated)

sequences.name: Sequence 1
sequences.query: activity_type:"process-create" AND (((((process_name:WLDi("*\\powershell.exe") OR process_command_line:WLDi("*powershell.exe*")) OR (process_name:WLDi("*\\pwsh.exe") OR process_command_line:WLDi("*pwsh.exe*")) OR (process_name:WLDi("*\\wmic.exe") OR process_command_line:WLDi("*wmic.exe*")) OR (process_name:WLDi("*\\vssadmin.exe") OR process_command_line:WLDi("*vssadmin.exe*")) OR (process_name:WLDi("*\\diskshadow.exe") OR process_command_line:WLDi("*diskshadow.exe*"))) OR ((process_name:"PowerShell.EXE" OR process_command_line:WLDi("*PowerShell.EXE*")) OR (process_name:"pwsh.dll" OR process_command_line:WLDi("*pwsh.dll*")) OR (process_name:"wmic.exe" OR process_command_line:WLDi("*wmic.exe*")) OR (process_name:"VSSADMIN.EXE" OR process_command_line:WLDi("*VSSADMIN.EXE*")) OR (process_name:"diskshadow.exe" OR process_command_line:WLDi("*diskshadow.exe*")))) AND (process_command_line:WLDi("*shadow*") OR process_command_line:WLDi("*delete*")))) OR ((((process_name:WLDi("*\\wbadmin.exe") OR process_command_line:WLDi("*wbadmin.exe*")) OR (process_name:"WBADMIN.EXE" OR process_command_line:WLDi("*WBADMIN.EXE*"))) AND (process_command_line:WLDi("*delete*") OR process_command_line:WLDi("*catalog*") OR process_command_line:WLDi("*quiet*")))) OR ((((process_name:WLDi("*\\vssadmin.exe") OR process_command_line:WLDi("*vssadmin.exe*")) OR (process_name:"VSSADMIN.EXE" OR process_command_line:WLDi("*VSSADMIN.EXE*"))) AND ((process_command_line:WLDi("*resize*") OR process_command_line:WLDi("*shadowstorage*")) AND (process_command_line:WLDi("*unbounded*") OR process_command_line:WLDi("*/MaxSize=*")))))
